description: User-scoped language runtimes. Installed as the target user, never by changing HOME under sudo. Versions are pinned in locks/.

node.note: pnpm and yarn come from corepack shims rather than separate globals.

jvm.note: SDKMAN owns every JVM installation; no JVM tooling comes from APT.

python.note: uv manages interpreters and project environments; the system Python stays untouched.

agents.note: Claude Code CLI, pinned to exact npm tarballs; authentication stays manual.
GitHub Copilot CLI, pinned to exact npm tarballs; authentication stays manual.

excluded.reason: Host Go toolchain not installed; Go work runs in containers.
Host Rust toolchain not installed; Rust work runs in containers.
